description: Whole-word boundary matching of sensitive field names: a sensitive name embedded as a proper sub-token (e.g. a plural or a longer compound where the configured name is not a standalone word) must NOT be treated as sensitive, whereas a sensitive name appearing as a standalone word delimited by non-word characters or whitespace MUST be redacted. The compound configured names are matched in full. Sensitive values are replaced by a run of asterisks whose length equals the byte length of the original value; non-sensitive fields pass through unchanged and key order is preserved. The output is the resulting payload serialized as a JSON object.
